scope: One continuous fictional book-swap chat, rated per assistant exchange against the actually supplied prompt, external support, and retained rolling context.

dimensions.label: Relevance/direct answer
dimensions.0: Does not address the user's request, is incoherent, or is materially off-topic.
dimensions.1: Touches part of the request but misses its main deliverable or is substantially indirect.
dimensions.2: Directly provides the requested deliverable or answer.

dimensions.label: Correctness/grounding in supplied user facts
dimensions.0: Contradicts, fabricates, or makes materially incorrect claims relative to supplied facts; unsupported factual claims are marked accordingly.
dimensions.1: Mostly safe but materially incomplete, vague, or includes a minor unsupported/error-prone assertion.
dimensions.2: Correctly uses supplied facts and makes no material unsupported or incorrect claim.

dimensions.label: Follows explicit instructions/constraints
dimensions.0: Violates a salient explicit instruction or fails to attempt the requested form/constraint.
dimensions.1: Attempts the instruction but misses a meaningful stated constraint or format element.
dimensions.2: Follows all material explicit instructions and constraints available in this exchange.

dimensions.label: Continuity with actual available context
dimensions.0: Contradicts or ignores material context that was actually supplied in this generation.
dimensions.1: Does not use relevant supplied context well, but does not materially contradict it, or it relies on unavailable older context.
dimensions.2: Consistent with and appropriately uses relevant actually supplied external support and retained pairs.

dimensions.label: Clarity/completeness/nonrepetition
dimensions.0: Unclear, substantially incomplete, or materially repetitive such that it is not usable.
dimensions.1: Understandable but notably incomplete, awkward, or somewhat repetitive.
dimensions.2: Clear, complete enough for the requested task, and nonrepetitive.

total.calculation: sum of five integer dimension scores

rules: Scores are explicit reviewer judgments; no score is derived from regex, length, stop flags, repetition metrics, or threshold classifiers.
A length or EOS stop may be noted as a cutoff but is not an automatic penalty.
Do not penalize failure to recall context that the recorded model input did not contain; distinguish it from ignoring actually supplied context.
Do not treat fluent but wrong answers as correct, and do not rate user-prompt authoring quality.
Creative wording may receive full credit without exact wording matches.
Unknown factual assertions are scored for grounding rather than assumed true.
